title: Improve conditional BIT c to 0.001736646042 with composed R437 and credited slot coalescing
body:
## Result

Compose the helper464 GL deletion with **Ali Romman's public #1043 helper470
deletion**, then apply **Sagar Thakrar's #3700 OQ4 slot coalescing**. The fully
charged conditional BIT coefficient is now

`c = 1736646042038446578551 / 1000000000000000000000000`

`= 0.001736646042038446578551`.

The next `10^-24` grid point fails. This follow-up improves this PR's original
coefficient by approximately **0.001024318895%**; it is an additional commit,
not a new PR or a restarted submission clock. The original R437 composition
already exceeded both reproduced #1043 and pending #2423 by more than 0.1%.

**Whole κ remains 0.001672660197076918.** Complex supply and the selected-result
metadata stay at their inherited values. This is a finite BIT supplier under
the stated selected interfaces, with maintainer admission pending.

## Concrete program change

The R437 word retains 111 SOURCE labels, 636 rational frames, 659 independent
input columns and nine paid rank7 captures. All original SOURCE/helper DIRTY
is restored. SOURCE77's replacement read occurs at its existing frame186;
SOURCE chronology and the capture windows are checked in both orientations.

The OQ4 follow-up changes exactly one placement:
`[6,210,0,8,6,422] -> [6,209,8,8,6,422]`.
Stage6 helper422 joins helper421 at offset8 in idle family209. All 32
replicas' corresponding owners are regenerated. Window6 now has 209 five-slot,
one two-slot and 12 empty families per replica. The new whole paid profile is

`{1:380160,2:400864,3:22176,4:26592,5:29376,6:17376,7:26496,26:32,42:384}`.

All 125856 helper owners and 7814016 emitted local-call events are checked.
W28416, physical28425, E903456, rankmass1808352, deficit10272, maximum child42
and halving depth2 are retained. The complete invoice includes the unchanged
bad-class fallback. Prefix177 bits is charged192, two-level393 is charged512,
and ROW18355 is below the inherited cap20161.

The new local-call stream digest is
`a777373994bd84681d6c2be75251ba6a04a1521580910f23afe09bb50db632b2`;
the complete schedule/owners/template content digest is
`c425a64739981b3ae3ed6b36d1a2f42c2d35e93f007649e89d4c677d8e158fe5`.
The word and all 27132 local records remain byte-identical to the original
R437 construction. Old proof and replay snapshots are retained as history.

## Reproduce and evidence

```sh
python research/bit-p111-r437-gl464-470-20261018/verify.py
```

This self-contained standard-library archive requires no network. Each child
uses a separate fresh Python cache namespace. It regenerates the actual word,
records, matching, owners, emitter, invoice and exact price; it checks all RAW
columns, rational frames, H1-H5, SOURCE/captures and the historical control.
`EXPECTED.json`, the package record, source pins and replay receipts identify
the current result. `REPLAY.json` describes the archive workflow.

The final isolated clean-export replay passed all **13 commands in 65.663s**.
Its receipt, `validation/R437-OQ4-COLD-REPLAY.json`, has SHA256
`266cdad360452acee74332c9a565fa3fcbe69da197061b24f117380e0a5fc93e`.

[#3700](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3700) at
`aa0bd9fbc8700506b1fafcc55bca9bd32aced7d9` independently reimplements the
original R437 word/hosting/price audit. We replayed that audit successfully.
Its unmodified hosting and rational-price engines also pass on our regenerated
OQ4 template, including the adjacent-grid bracket. Overlapping slots, a stale
owner and the old profile at the new coefficient are rejected as controls.
This second use is our local cross-check, not an external endorsement of the
new commit. Hosted CI and formal maintainer approval are not claimed.

## Assumptions, attribution and next questions

The inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-SOURCE/target-label,
common-field/ρ/cover, correlated-hosting and precision/tape/analytic interfaces
remain conditional. COPY uses one paid transform plus retained linear
complete-private-stream discard. The new capture-scope note states the
arbitrary-stream hypothesis explicitly and explains the dirty-helper column
substitution identified by #3700 OQ1; it does not supply a new physical
all-size realization. Finite audit, CI, admission and a multiplication theorem
are separate claims. The historical outer diagnostic is not a current κ claim.

Credit **Ali Romman (@aliromman)** for #1043's helper470 deletion and source
boundary proof, and **Sagar Thakrar (@thakrarsagar)** for #3700 OQ4 and the
capture-column observation. This PR contributes the helper464/470 composition,
the complete regenerated owner/invoice realization and reproducible packaging.
Preserve eumemic, DreamingOfClouds, #545/#543/#555, Dylan Crow, DaysSky's #442,
chafreaky and the full predecessor notices. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
was used here; #3700 discloses substantial Claude assistance. Apache-2.0 and
all inherited notices are retained.

Open work is a new carrier construction surviving every future observation
with complete owner costs, and a formal realization of the inherited SOURCE
and all-size interfaces. Neither is asserted by this finite result.
